text: おれは　そんな　きたえ　ぬかれた　かくとうポケモン　たちと　ともに　いきてきた！

structure.jp: そんな　きたえ　ぬかれた　かくとうポケモン　たちと　ともに
structure.en: together with Fighting Pokémon trained to the utmost like that

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action has kept going from the past up to now. いきてきた = 'have lived all this time'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きたえ　ぬかれた　かくとうポケモン
patterns.explanation: The phrase before the Pokémon tells you what kind they are; ぬく adds 'to the very end' and れた means it was done to them. きたえ　ぬかれた　かくとうポケモン = 'Fighting Pokémon that have been trained to the utmost'.

patterns.name: 〜とともに
patterns.explanation: と　ともに after someone means 'together with' them, in a slightly formal tone. かくとうポケモン　たちと　ともに = 'together with Fighting Pokémon'.
